questions.question: The value of (1)/(2²)+(1)/(2³) div((1)/(2)+(1)/(2) div 1) + 3 (1)/(3) div (5)/(2) times (3)/(4) div 6 (2)/(3) times (7)/(6) is:

questions.question: The population of a town increases annually by 20%. If the present population is 80lakh, then what is the difference between the population three years ago and 2years ago?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The population of a town increases annually by 20%. If the present population is 80 lakh, then what is the difference between the population three years ago and 2 years ago?

**Formula used:**

Future Population = Present Population × (1 + Growth Rate)ⁿ

Past Population = Present Population / (1 + Growth Rate)ⁿ

Where,

Growth Rate = 20% = 0.2

n = number of years

**Calculation:**

Population 2 years ago:

⇒ Population₂ = 80 lakh / (1 + 0.2)²

⇒ Population₂ = 80 lakh / 1.44

⇒ Population₂ = 55.5556 lakh

Population 3 years ago:

⇒ Population₃ = 80 lakh / (1 + 0.2)³

⇒ Population₃ = 80 lakh / 1.728

⇒ Population₃ = 46.2963 lakh

Difference between population three years ago and 2 years ago:

⇒ Difference = Population₂ - Population₃

⇒ Difference = 55.5556 lakh - 46.2963 lakh

⇒ Difference = 9.2593 lakh

**∴ The correct answer is option 1 (925925.93).**

questions.question: Rajan and Rajat can do a work in 64 days and 48 days, respectively. Starting with Rajat, they work on alternate days. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rajan can complete the work in 64 days.

Rajat can complete the work in 48 days.

**Formula used:**

Total units of work = LCM of 64 and 48 = 192 units

Rajan’s work rate = 192/64 = 3 units/day

Rajat’s work rate = 192/48 = 4 units/day

**Calculation:**

Work done in two days = Rajat’s work + Rajan’s work = 4 + 3 = 7 units

Total work = 192 units, Number of complete 2-day cycles = 192/7 = 27 cycles and remainder 3 units

In 27 cycles, 189 units are completed in 54 days.

Remaining work = 192 - 189 = 3 units, which Rajat completes on the 55th day, 3/4 units.

**∴ The total number of days to complete the work is 54³ / ₄ days.**

questions.question: A dishonest dealer sells an article at a 10% loss on the cost price but uses a weight of 40 g instead of 50 g. What is his percentage of profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A dishonest dealer sells an article at a 10% loss on the cost price but uses a weight of 40 g instead of 50 g.

**Formula used:**

Profit Percentage = (dfrac{S.P. - C.P.}{C.P.}) times 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of 50 g be ₹100.

Selling price of 50 g at a 10% loss = ₹100 - 10% of ₹100

⇒ S.P. = ₹100 - ₹10

⇒ S.P. = ₹90

But dealer uses 40 g instead of 50 g, so he sells 40 g at ₹90.

Cost price of 40 g = dfrac{100}{50} times 40 = ₹80

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

⇒ Profit = ₹90 - ₹80

⇒ Profit = ₹10

Profit Percentage = (dfrac{10}{80}) times 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 12.5%

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A trader gives a 40% discount on his goods. Further, he gives 20% discount on the goods. Find the single discount equivalent to these two successive discounts.
questions.solution:

A trader gives a 40% discount on his goods. Further, he gives a 20% discount on the goods.

Single equivalent discount, D = D₁ + D₂ - (D₁ × D₂)/100

Where, D₁ = first discount, D₂ = second discount

**Calculation:**

D₁ = 40%, D₂ = 20%

⇒ D = 40 + 20 - (40 × 20)/100

⇒ D = 60 - 8

⇒ D = 52%

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 486 cm² and its sides are in the ratio 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5. The perimeter of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a triangle is 486 cm² and its sides are in the ratio 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5.

**Formula used:**

Area = √(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c))

Where s = semi-perimeter and a, b, c are the sides of the triangle

**Calculation:**

Let the sides of the triangle be 3x, 4x, and 5x.

Perimeter = 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x

Semi-perimeter (s) = 12x / 2 = 6x

Area = 486 cm²

⇒ √(6x(6x-3x)(6x-4x)(6x-5x)) = 486

⇒ √(6x × 3x × 2x × x) = 486

⇒ √(36x⁴) = 486

⇒ 6x² = 486

⇒ x² = 81

⇒ x = 9

Perimeter = 12x = 12 × 9 = 108 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: A drink is made by mixing water and juice in the ratio 9 ∶ 7. If x litres of water and 2x litres of juice are mixed in 160 litres of drink, then the new ratio becomes 13 ∶ 15. The quantity of drink (in litres) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A drink is made by mixing water and juice in the ratio 9 ∶ 7.

If x litres of water and 2x litres of juice are mixed in 160 litres of drink, then the new ratio becomes 13 ∶ 15.

**Formula used:**

Initial ratio of water to juice = 9/7

New ratio of water to juice = 13/15

**Calculation:**

Given initial ratio: 9/7

New ratio: 13/15

Total drink = 160 litres

Let x be the litres of water and 2x be the litres of juice added.

Total water = (9/16) × 160 + x = 90 + x

Total juice = (7/16) × 160 + 2x = 70 + 2x

New ratio: (90 + x)/(70 + 2x) = 13/15

⇒ 15(90 + x) = 13(70 + 2x)

⇒ 1350 + 15x = 910 + 26x

⇒ 1350 - 910 = 26x - 15x

⇒ 440 = 11x

⇒ x = 40

Total quantity of drink = 160 + x + 2x

⇒ Total quantity = 160 + 40 + 80

⇒ Total quantity = 280 litres

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question:
Find the value of the following expression.

(1 + tan θ + sec θ) × ( 1 + cot θ - cosec θ)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(1 + tan θ + sec θ) × (1 + cot θ - cosec θ)

**Formula used:**

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ

sec θ = 1 / cos θ

cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

**Calculation:**

(1 + tan θ + sec θ) × (1 + cot θ - cosec θ)

⇒ (1 + sin θ / cos θ + 1 / cos θ) × (1 + cos θ / sin θ - 1 / sin θ)

⇒ (1 + (sin θ + 1) / cos θ) × (1 + (cos θ - 1) / sin θ)

⇒ (cos θ + sin θ + 1) / cos θ × (sin θ + cos θ - 1) / sin θ

⇒ [(cos θ + sin θ + 1) × (sin θ + cos θ - 1)] / (cos θ × sin θ)

Expanding the numerator:

⇒ (cos² θ + cos θ sin θ - cos θ + sin θ cos θ + sin² θ - sin θ + cos θ + sin θ - 1)

⇒ (cos² θ + sin² θ + 2 cos θ sin θ - 1)

Using the Pythagorean identity, cos² θ + sin² θ = 1:

⇒ (1 + 2 cos θ sin θ - 1)

⇒ 2 cos θ sin θ

Thus, the expression simplifies to:

⇒ 2 cos θ sin θ / (cos θ sin θ)

⇒ 2

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 13 and ab + bc + ca = 22, then the value of a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If a + b + c = 13 and ab + bc + ca = 22

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca)

**Calculation:**

a + b + c = 13

ab + bc + ca = 22

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 13² = a² + b² + c² + 2(22)

⇒ 169 = a² + b² + c² + 44

⇒ a² + b² + c² = 169 - 44

⇒ a² + b² + c² = 125

Now, a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 13(125 - 22)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 13 × 103

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 1339

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: A hostel had food provision for 300 students for a month. After 20 days, 50 students left the hostel. How long would the remaining food last? (1 month = 30 days)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Remaining food for **300 students** is for **10 days** (30 − 20 = 10).

Students remaining = 300 − 50 = **250 students**.

Using **M₁D₁ = M₂D₂**: 300 × 10 = 250 × D.

D = 3000 ÷ 250 = **12 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca73f89cd369ca6a4a33ff132643a7593c8d0cac572a9e1735308b7c0c066bc5.png] 

**Given:**

Total students = **300**

Total provision = **30 days**

Days elapsed = **20 days**

Students left = **50**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Work (Total food units) = 300 × 30 = **9000 units**

⇒ Food consumed in 20 days = 300 × 20 = **6000 units**

⇒ Remaining food = 9000 − 6000 = **3000 units**

⇒ Remaining students = 300 − 50 = **250 students**

⇒ Number of days food will last = 3000 ÷ 250

⇒ Days = **12 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (Work and Person)

The formula used is **M₁D₁H₁/W₁ = M₂D₂H₂/W₂**, where M is men, D is days, H is hours, and W is work.

Inverse Proportion

The number of **days** is **inversely proportional** to the number of **men** for a constant amount of food/work.

Remaining Food Concept

Always calculate the **remaining man-days** by multiplying the initial number of people by the remaining number of days.</p

questions.question: If the simple interest on a certain sum of money for 20 months at the rate of 19.2% per annum exceeds the simple interest on the same sum for 15 months at the rate of 11.2% p.a. by Rs. 2,920, then what is the sum (in Rs., to the nearest hundreds)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Difference in Simple Interest = Rs. 2,920

Rate 1 = 19.2% p.a., Time 1 = 20 months (which is 20/12 = 5/3 years)

Rate 2 = 11.2% p.a., Time 2 = 15 months (which is 15/12 = 5/4 years)

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Difference in Simple Interest = SI for 20 months - SI for 15 months

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be 'P'.

SI for 20 months = (P × 19.2 × 5/3) / 100

⇒ SI for 20 months = (P × 32) / 100

SI for 15 months = (P × 11.2 × 5/4) / 100

⇒ SI for 15 months = (P × 14) / 100

Difference in SI = SI for 20 months - SI for 15 months

⇒ (P × 32) / 100 - (P × 14) / 100 = 2,920

⇒ (P × (32 - 14)) / 100 = 2,920

⇒ (P × 18) / 100 = 2,920

⇒ P = (2,920 × 100) / 18

⇒ P = Rs. 16,222.22

**∴ The sum is Rs. 16,200 (nearest hundred).**

questions.question: A 234 m long train passes a person running at 9 km/h in the opposite direction, in 6 seconds. In how much time (in seconds) will it pass another person who is moving at 23.4 km/h, in the same direction?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 234 m long train passes a person running at 9 km/h in the opposite direction, in 6 seconds.

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Train + Speed of Person (opposite direction)

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

Speed of person = 9 km/h = 9 × (1000/3600) m/s = 2.5 m/s

Let the speed of the train be x m/s

Relative Speed = x + 2.5 m/s

Distance = 234 m

Time = 6 seconds

⇒ 234 = 6 × (x + 2.5)

⇒ 234 = 6x + 15

⇒ 6x = 234 - 15

⇒ 6x = 219

⇒ x = 219 / 6

⇒ x = 36.5 m/s

Speed of the second person = 23.4 km/h = 23.4 × (1000/3600) m/s = 6.5 m/s

Relative Speed = 36.5 - 6.5 m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = 30 m/s

Distance = 234 m

⇒ Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 234 / 30

⇒ Time = 7.8 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: Sapna is double efficient as compared to Rakesh. If they both work together on a project and complete it in 48 days, then the number of days in which Sapna alone can complete the project is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency Ratio (**Sapna** : **Rakesh**) = 2 : 1

Total Efficiency = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day

Total Work = Total Efficiency × Total Days = 3 × **48 days** = 144 units

**Sapna**'s alone time = Total Work ÷ **Sapna**'s efficiency = 144 ÷ 2 = **72 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 72 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Efficiency of **Sapna** = 2 × Efficiency of **Rakesh**

Time taken together = **48 days**

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of **Rakesh** be 1 unit/day.

⇒ Efficiency of **Sapna** = 2 × 1 = 2 units/day.

⇒ Combined efficiency of (**Sapna** + **Rakesh**) = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Total Work = Combined efficiency × Combined time = 3 × 48 = 144 units.

⇒ Time taken by **Sapna** alone = Total Work ÷ **Sapna**'s efficiency

⇒ Time = 144 ÷ 2 = 72 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 72 days.**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The time taken to complete a work is **inversely proportional** to the efficiency of the worker (Time ∝ 1/Efficiency).

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the **work done**, which depends on both efficiency and the duration of work.

Combined Efficiency Rule

When individuals work together, their **individual efficiencies** are added to find the total rate of work per day.</p
